title: Boundary retaining wall: notice to fix withdrawn (Cromwell)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Owners built a low retaining wall near the boundary without consent, believing it exempt; the neighbouring site was later developed with a driveway near the top of the wall.
Authority issued notice to fix NF0115 for contravening s40 on a surcharge basis, later withdrew it and applied for a determination.
Determination examines whether the wall was exempt under Schedule 1 and whether later surcharge needed to be considered in the design.
